title: Netlify Build & Runtime Diagnostics Ontology
description: Deterministic rules, triggers, and self-healing patches for all known Netlify failure states.

rules.title: Linux Filesystem Case Sensitivity Mismatch
rules.trigger: Asset 404 on CI / Netlify Linux build while resolving locally on macOS or Windows.
rules.root_cause: Linux filesystems (ext4/xfs) are case-sensitive. References like `/assets/Image.png` fail when the disk has `/assets/image.png`.
rules.detection_regex: Cannot find file|404 Not Found.*assets|no such file or directory
rules.self_heal_action: AST scanner inspects directory contents case-insensitively and updates HTML/JS/CSS string references to exact disk casing.

rules.title: Circular or Infinite Redirect Loop
rules.trigger: Browser error: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS or Netlify Deploy validation failure.
rules.root_cause: A redirect entry in `_redirects` or `netlify.toml` redirects a path back to itself (e.g. `/hub -> /hub` or recursive `:splat`).
rules.self_heal_action: Graph cycle detector removes self-referential rules and normalizes splat targets.

rules.title: Serverless Function Package Exceeds 50 MB
rules.trigger: Netlify build packaging error: Function exceeds uncompressed size limit.
rules.root_cause: Heavy node modules, ML models, or static assets bundled inside `netlify/functions` exceed AWS Lambda / Netlify limits.
rules.detection_regex: exceeds Netlify Lambda size limit of 50 MB|Function package too large
rules.self_heal_action: Configures `esbuild` bundler with `external_node_modules` exclusion list in `netlify.toml`.

rules.title: Node.js Version Engine Mismatch
rules.trigger: npm ERR! notsup Unsupported engine for package, or build failure on modern ES syntax.
rules.root_cause: Netlify build default image defaults to older LTS Node while package.json requires Node >=20.
rules.detection_regex: requires Node.js engine|notsup Unsupported engine|NODE_VERSION mismatch

rules.title: Single Page Application Sub-Route 404
rules.trigger: Direct URL reload or bookmark on clean URLs returns Netlify 404 Page Not Found.
rules.root_cause: Missing client-side rewrite fallback rule (`/* /index.html 200`) in `_redirects` or `netlify.toml`.
rules.detection_regex: Page Not Found on direct route reload|404 on deep link

rules.title: Hardcoded Secret / API Key in Public Assets
rules.trigger: Red-team regex detector matches `sk-*`, `ghp_*`, `AIza*` in public bundle files.
rules.root_cause: Developer inadvertently hardcoded a private API token in client-side HTML or JS.
rules.self_heal_action: Redacts plaintext secret, logs warning, and generates `netlify env:set` migration command.

rules.title: Missing or Misconfigured Publish Directory
rules.trigger: Netlify deploy error: 'Deploy directory does not exist'.
rules.root_cause: `publish` setting in `netlify.toml` points to wrong path (e.g. `dist` vs `public` vs `build`).
rules.detection_regex: Deploy directory does not exist|publish directory not found
rules.self_heal_action: Detects actual build artifact folder and aligns `[build] publish` property.

rules.title: CDN Edge Cache Drift or Stale Asset Revalidation
rules.trigger: Visitors see stale content after deploy due to aggressive edge caching.
rules.root_cause: Missing `must-revalidate` on HTML routes alongside long max-age headers.
rules.self_heal_action: Harmonizes `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600, must-revalidate` on HTML and `max-age=604800` on `/assets/*`.
